nodes.label: React Logo - 1x/2x/3x density variants
nodes.description: React framework logo in cyan-blue (#61DAFF / rgb(97,218,251)). Available in three density variants: react-logo.png (100x100), react-logo@2x.png (200x200), react-logo@3x.png (300x300). The classic React atom/orbital logo used in example/boilerplate screens.
